The Scenic Eclipse II, a state-of-the-art expedition cruise vessel, became stuck in pack ice while navigating the Ross Sea near McMurdo Sound late Friday night. With progress stalled and no safe passage in sight, the crew called for assistance. The nearest help? The USCGC Polar Star‚ÄîAmerica‚Äôs only active heavy icebreaker, now marking 50 years in service.
